profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, and trades under the ticker CRNC. According to its website, it delivers conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, built on CaLLM, which the company describes as its family of advanced language models. The company says it provides tailor-made AI solutions that integrate with vehicles while preserving a manufacturer's brand identity, and that it is advancing generative AI and LLM-powered innovation it expects to be central to automotive and transportation user experiences.

The site highlights Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), described as already deployed in production vehicles. The company says EVD detects and localizes more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, identifying approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away using interior microphones and beyond 800 meters when paired with exterior microphones. The site also describes dynamic speech enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments, demonstrated by Timo Matheja and Stefan Hamerich, and work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants.

Cerence reports third quarter results with revenue up 12% year over year, connected services revenue up 20% year over year, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program. Its SEC filing record lists CIK 0001768267. Litigation exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with 191 cases.
